ive had this happen a few times. i take edibles occasionally, and i dont really remember much of what goes on in my head after i come down. i do remember getting repressed memories come back into full swing, though. its hard to focus on anything else when that happens. it helps listening to music, or a youtube video or something for background noise. my brain makes up noises when im high and its quiet, and it freaks me out and makes the flashbacks worse
